items.title: A separated finite-type scheme of dimension at most 1 over a field is H-quasi-projective
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The proof combines the delivered ample-sheaf proposition for dimension-1 separated Noetherian schemes with the standard morphisms lemma that ample invertible sheaves give locally closed immersions into projective space, and then cites the definition of H-quasi-projective. H2: two named inputs in sequence with no additional construction.
